# technitium_settings_proxy (Resource)

Manages the outbound proxy used for recursion, forwarding and block list downloads.

This is a singleton: declare it once. Attributes left unset follow the server's current value. Destroying the resource only removes it from state; server settings are not reset.



<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Optional

- `address` (String) Proxy host.
- `bypass` (List of String) Addresses, networks or names never sent through the proxy.
- `password` (String, Sensitive) Proxy password. Not readable from the server.
- `port` (Number) Proxy port.
- `type` (String) `None`, `Http` or `Socks5`.
- `username` (String) Proxy username.

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) Always `settings`.
